basis: Normal continuation is SAME MAIN at observed END+60. The same recurring hourly RRULE is the built-in cold fallback; active work uses one verified +660s provisional with at most one guarded extension. Predictive prearm is rolled back and Watchdog is disabled standby.
same_canonical_overlap_assumption: Newest verified future DTSTART wins. Stale occurrences recover forward and may not roll state or authority backward.
fallback_guarantee_target: A lost shifted wake remains recoverable by the SAME MAIN natural hourly RRULE occurrence without Watchdog.

measurement.live_run_useful_span: Measure observed substantive boundaries; never infer hidden work.
measurement.recovery_gap: Measure last meaningful predecessor progress to first meaningful replacement progress for abrupt loss.
measurement.normal_continuation_gap: Measure actual predecessor END/last useful boundary, scheduled fast due, successor observation/BOOT_STARTED, and successor first useful boundary separately.
measurement.product_slo: Optimize wall-clock useful-work coverage union, not nominal turn count.
